key_insight: FlexPart brings different levels of geometric control into one image-to-3D part generation model. Users can guide generation with sparse points or more detailed inputs such as bounding boxes and masks.
problem_solved: Existing 3D part generation methods lack the flexibility to support workflows that require different amounts and types of user guidance.
method: Introduce a unified image-to-3D part generation framework supporting variable-granularity geometric conditions.
Accept heterogeneous guidance, including sparse points, bounding boxes, and masks.
Integrate these inputs through gated adaptive modulation within a single model.
impact: FlexPart could let practitioners support both lightweight guidance and detailed geometric constraints without maintaining separate models for each input type. The supplied abstract is truncated, so performance gains and experimental validation cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: source image plus geometric guidance → FlexPart → generated 3D parts.

Fusion schematic showing heterogeneous inputs integrated through gated adaptive modulation.
Conceptual 3D object illustration with individual parts highlighted in distinct colors.
paper_title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
paper_authors: Qiwen Gu, Xin Zhou, Xiwu Chen, Zhongyang Zhu, Zhuo Zhang
